svg.aria-label: TypeSafe publishes Jev as 40 to 200 times faster and 40 to 400 times cheaper than a frontier LLM on small decisions. Both are ranges, and both are vendor figures rather than independent measurements.

g.text: These are TypeSafe's own published figures, not independent benchmarks — and they describe small decisions,
not the open-ended work an LLM is actually good at. Measure your own case before you bet on them.
